purpose: Protect platform-specific accessibility and localization outcomes, evidence boundaries, custom-control freedom, and honest completion claims.

cases.prompt: Adapt an established focus-session flow from iPhone to iPad and Mac. Define what accessibility acceptance is actually needed on each platform.
expected_behavior: Define the real core task and select platform-specific inputs and assistive behaviors by risk.
Cover iOS touch, iPad keyboard and pointer, and macOS window, menu, command, focus, and keyboard behavior.
Require named runtime evidence before claiming a platform or assistive-technology path is verified.
forbidden_behavior: Stretch the iPhone checklist across every platform.
Claim that one VoiceOver or label check proves accessibility on all platforms.

plugins/apple-ui-design/skills/apple-pla: core-task matrix for each target platform

cases.prompt: The UI tests pass performAccessibilityAudit and assert labels, values, and actions. Confirm that the checkout is fully VoiceOver verified.
expected_behavior: Classify the supplied evidence as semantic or automated evidence.
Refuse the VoiceOver completion claim without an actual VoiceOver core-task run.
Provide a manual device or supported runtime path and name the remaining unverified scenarios.
forbidden_behavior: Report VoiceOver passed because the audit is clean.
Use the broad word accessible without naming scope and evidence.

plugins/apple-ui-design/references/acces: It is not a VoiceOver run.
Never collapse these into a broad "accessible" claim.
plugins/apple-ui-design/skills/apple-ui-: Do not report an audit, label check, or UI test as a VoiceOver

cases.prompt: Keep our branded radial timer instead of replacing it with the system picker. Define how to make and verify it accessible.
expected_behavior: Preserve the confirmed visual and interaction direction unless a hard task boundary fails.
Define role, name, value, state, actions, focus, result, and recovery.
Provide equivalent operations for relevant touch, keyboard, pointer, and assistive-technology paths.
forbidden_behavior: Treat accessibility as labels without operating the task.

plugins/apple-ui-design/references/acces: A custom control does not need to resemble a system control.
role: what kind of thing it is
result: whether the intended task actually changes state and completes

cases.prompt: Review a translucent status card that uses green, yellow, and red plus spatial animation to communicate all state changes.
expected_behavior: Check the current Apple contrast thresholds and actual material backgrounds.
Require non-color state meaning and preserve it under Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency.
Define a Reduce Motion alternative that retains state, feedback, and appropriate brand expression.
forbidden_behavior: Approve color-only or motion-only state meaning.
Require all transparency and animation to be removed in every mode.

plugins/apple-ui-design/references/acces: 17 pt and smaller regular text uses at least 4.5:1
Do not remove required feedback by disabling all animation.

cases.prompt: Prepare a finance confirmation flow for English, Arabic, Polish, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean without waiting for final translations.
expected_behavior: Use pseudolanguages for early structural evidence and real target languages for acceptance.
Cover RTL, plurals, grammatical variation, regional dates and numbers, and CJK content.
Prevent hardcoded formatting and concatenated sentence fragments.
forbidden_behavior: Treat doubled English as localization completion.
Mechanically mirror digits, logos, and universal symbols.

plugins/apple-ui-design/references/acces: Do not mechanically reverse digit order

cases.prompt: VoiceOver can complete the main task. Mark Voice Control, Switch Control, AssistiveTouch, Full Keyboard Access, and Pointer Control as passed too.
expected_behavior: Limit the verified claim to the named VoiceOver task and represented environment.
Define separate task paths for each other relevant technology and input.
Choose final device or Mac evidence based on platform capability.
forbidden_behavior: Transfer a VoiceOver result to unrelated assistive technologies.
Claim all accessibility is complete from one assistive-technology run.

plugins/apple-ui-design/references/acces: A screen reader pass does not establish Voice Control
